featured.name: The Rain Court House

image.alt: House with a long reflecting pool through the garden

featured.heading: Quiet rooms gather around a living courtyard.
featured.description: Designed for a multi-generational family, the residence turns inward to a rain garden that brings daylight, breeze and the sound of water into every room. Local stone, lime plaster and finely detailed teak temper the bold concrete shell.

title: The Courtyard
House
caseStudy.lead: Concept: a calm family home organised around a planted courtyard that draws light, rain and breeze into every room.
body: a narrow, busy-road site with close neighbours, strong western heat and heavy monsoon rain.
an inward-looking plan with deep overhangs, teak screens and cross-ventilation — private, cool and open to the landscape.
